name: directional-scroll-indicator
title: Directional Scroll Indicator
description: An animated navigational arrow cue indicating the axis and distance remaining in an active viewport section.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Viewport Direction Cue: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
